title: bStocks Now Available on Binance Convert From Just 0.01 USDC Equivalent
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. bStocks are Tokenized securities issued by BTech Holdings Limited, a Binance group affiliate. bStocks are classified as Certificates representing certain Financial Instruments (paragraph 92, Schedule 1 to FSMR). bStocks represent an interest in underlying securities held by the Issuer and are not direct ownership of the underlying Shares. bStocks do not allow holders to directly own a share or stock in the underlying listed company. Fellow Binancians, Binance users in eligible regions can now access  bStocks  through  Convert , starting from just  0.01 USDC equivalent . bStocks are tokenized securities each backed 1:1 by a US share held at a regulated custodian. bStocks are the first tokenized securities admitted to the  FSRA Official List  - issued under an FSRA-approved Prospectus and traded on a Recognised Investment Exchange. Trade bStocks on Binance Convert Eligible users can now: Start small from just 0.01 USDC equivalent : Access fractional US stocks exposure from as little as 0.01 USDC. Trade 24/7  on the spot market with no market hour restrictions. Fully backed by real shares  held at a regulated custodian, and publicly verifiable. Enter the amount and confirm your purchase. For users verified in the following countries/regions  here : You can access bStocks via  Convert  through  Binance   Web , bStocks will be made available in the next upcoming App upgrade version (iOS: 3.16.0, Android: 3.16.3). On the Binance  Web : Click  [Trade],  select  “Convert & Block Trade” . Search for your preferred bStock. Enter the amount and confirm your trade. Start your bStocks portfolio today from just 0.01 USDC, alongside millions of Binance users. Note : There may be discrepancies between this original content in English and any translated versions.
